fields.value: Dataset for flow reactor experiments on alpha-pinene ozonolysis and autoxidation utilising advanced isotopic labelling and CI-orbitrap

dsDescriptionValue.value: The dataset for the article "Selective deuteration reveals the importance of multiple branching pathways in alpha-pinene autoxidation" and the full dataset from the flow reactor experiments on a-pinene ozonolysis and autoxidation utilizing advanced isotopic labelling and CI-orbitrap. Contains the explanations for all the data, CI-orbitrap data, diary, and relevant information for enabling data processing from raw data using Orbitool.

datasetVersion.citation: Nonspecified et al, 2025,  Dataset for flow reactor experiments on alpha-pinene ozonolysis and autoxidation utilising advanced isotopic labelling and CI-orbitrap, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13348072
